visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with layered brown hair and a black sweatshirt featuring a KAWS graphic sits in an indoor room with large windows. He holds a black wireless microphone to his mouth, speaking directly to the camera. A teal cup sits on a light wood table in front of him. (2) A screen recording overlay shows the official Tesla website with a silver Model Y and Traditional Chinese text. (3) The man continues talking in the same indoor setting, gesturing with his hands. (4) Close-up product shots show a silver Tesla Model Y, focusing on its headlights, side profile, and wheels with a multi-spoke design. (5) Digital interface captures show the car's configuration options, including paint colors and pricing details. (6) A snippet of stock footage shows luggage being placed in a car's trunk. (7) A close-up view of the interior shows a minimalist dashboard, a large touchscreen, and a redesigned steering wheel. (8) The video concludes with the man in the original setting inviting the audience to comment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天早上特斯拉突然開賣. [Logo]: @daddy.iam. (2) [Slogan]: 全新 Model Y. [Logo]: TESLA. (3) [Subtitle]: 新版本的 Model Y 到底怎麼買. (4) [Subtitle]: 貫穿式頭燈真的好帥. (5) [Subtitle]: 目前只有開賣LR的版本. (6) [Subtitle]: 售價是244萬9900. (7) [Subtitle]: 現在舊版的 Model Y 官網的現貨車也有特價. (8) [Subtitle]: 如果你是講求CP值的. [Slogan]: 只要168萬. (9) [Subtitle]: 比之前便宜了將近10萬. (10) [Subtitle]: 特斯拉一向從官網上面訂購就可以. (11) [Subtitle]: 新版本的 Y 目前只有黑色跟銀色可以選. (12) [Subtitle]: 銀色是閃電銀 我自己覺得很好看. (13) [Subtitle]: 這次啊我是訂銀色 先搶先贏. (14) [Subtitle]: 要不要交車之後再想. (15) [Subtitle]: 輪圈目前只有20吋不能選. (16) [Subtitle]: EAP跟FSD強烈建議不用現在買. (17) [Subtitle]: 等交車以後再線上刷卡就好. (18) [Subtitle]: 接著刷卡1萬塊就完成訂單. (19) [Subtitle]: 預計會等四到五個月通知交車. (20) [Subtitle]: 對比於舊的 Model Y 新版的啊在馬力跟續航都有一點提升. (21) [Subtitle]: 有一個比較大的亮點是行李箱後座的椅背是可以電動調整. (22) [Subtitle]: 新的操作語言與內裝跟之前換新版的3差不多. (23) [Subtitle]: 也一樣少了排檔桿 多了車內的氣氛燈. (24) [Subtitle]: 還有我覺得最重要的通風座椅. (25) [Subtitle]: 你會訂嗎 在底下留言告訴我.
